PAUSED

Traversal sandbox. Two independent grapples, momentum-true swing physics, wall-runs, slides and a gas boost. Fly through the gold rings, and cut the glowing nape on the training titans: hit it fast (14+ m/s) or with a heavy move for a one-hit kill.

Q / EFire left / right waist hook. Hold to stay hooked, release to let go
HOOK HITAuto-reels you straight in and hangs you at the point
WASD (reeling)Keep your momentum: A/D whip around the point, W over the top, S under. Let go of Q/E to fling off
SHIFTHold to stop reeling and swing / hang instead
SPACE × 2Super dash: instant burst where you're looking (35 gas)
SPACE (reeling)Boost reel: burns gas, much faster
1Equip / sheathe the sword
2Pulse rifle: hold M1 for auto fire. Pin-point first shots, headshots crit. Builds heat - overheat = 1.6 s cooldown
3Thunder spears: M1 throws an explosive javelin that sticks and detonates (4 charges, regen). Blast yourself for a rocket jump
M1Sword: 3-hit combo on the ground, spin slash in the air
HOLD M1Charge, release for a power slash that throws an energy wave
C + M1 (air)Plunge slam straight down
M1 near a titanAuto lock-on: glides you onto the nape
Space / Q / E mid-swingCancel the attack into a jump, dash or grapple
Chain 12 hitsFRENZY: faster swings, endless gas, instant super dashes
Super dash through a nape (sword out)PIERCE: one-shot kill
